data.text: Criterion 2 is configured, not yet seen: ci.yml now runs npx, pnpm-dlx and bunx on all three OS, but only a push runs it, and pushing is the owner's call. Locally on macOS all three pass, and a tarball with dist/cli.js removed fails 8 checks once directories holding a global kadence are taken off PATH — before that guard, npx quietly ran /opt/homebrew/bin/kadence and every check passed.
